review_notes: I read the whole file and checked it against Mathlib's KanComplex/MulStruct.lean, RelativeMorphism.lean and ProdStdSimplexOne.lean. The file builds on Mathlib's existing `PtSimplex.RelStruct`, `RelStruct₀`, `MulStruct`, `RelativeMorphism.Homotopy` and `RelativeMorphism.ofSimplex₀`. `Homotopy` is only an abbrev for `RelativeMorphism.Homotopy`, so it is not a competing version of that concept. `RelStruct.symm`, `RelStruct.trans`, `MulStruct.unique` and `MulStruct.postcomp` have no counterparts in Mathlib's KanComplex directory (my grep there found nothing). The private `collapse` map `Δ[p] ⊗ Δ[1] ⟶ Δ[p+1]` and the declarations that use it have no Mathlib counterpart in SimplicialSet either. The `RelStruct₀.symm` and `RelStruct₀.trans` abbrevs are named specialisations of the general versions. I found no justified duplicate. I did not search the whole of Mathlib exhaustively, so a counterpart outside the directories I grepped is possible.
